description_en: Queries all phone numbers used for sending messages and their statuses for a customer

kebab_example: aliyun cams query-chatapp-phone-numbers --isv-code aksik93kdkkxmwol90000 --cust-space-id 293483938840000 --status VERIFIED --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.name: isv_code

parameters.help_en: The Space ID of the ISV sub-customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id

parameters.help_en: The status of the phone number
